Morocco vs Comoros - African Cup of Nations - Morocco 2025
programme.desc:
African Cup Of Nations
This will be the second meeting between Morocco and Comoros at the CAF Africa Cup of Nations. Their only previous encounter produced a 2-0 Morocco victory, in the group stages in January 2022. This is Comoros’ second appearance at the CAF Africa Cup of Nations. Their inaugural participation was in 2022 – they lost three of their four matches but nevertheless reached the round of 16 where they were knocked out by hosts Cameroon.

Mali vs Zambia - African Cup of Nations - Morocco 2025
programme.desc:
Live - African Cup Of Nations
Mali conceded only one goal in their six qualifying matches for the 2025 AFCON, the joint-best defensive total alongside Senegal. This is Zambia’s 19th appearance at the CAF Africa Cup of Nations. The Chipolopolo won the title in 2012, beating Côte d’Ivoire on penalties after a goalless final..

programme.title: South Africa vs Angola - African Cup of Nations - Morocco 2025
programme.desc:
Live - African Cup Of Nations
South Africa are unbeaten against Angola at the CAF Africa Cup of Nations. They will be meeting for the fifth time at the tournament, all in the group stages. This is South Africa’s 12th participation in the CAF Africa Cup of Nations. They won AFCON on their debut, back in 1996.

programme.title: Egypt vs Zimbabwe - African Cup of Nations - Morocco 2025
programme.desc:
Live - African Cup Of Nations
This will be the third AFCON encounter between Egypt and Zimbabwe, with each of them taking place in North Africa. The two previous meetings produced Egyptian victories, both in the group stages: 2004 and 2019. This is Egypt’s 27th appearance at the CAF Africa Cup of Nations, a record in the history of the tournament. They have won it seven times – more than any other side – and have also reached the final in five of their last seven participations.
